facts.text: The hotel is one minute away from Piazza San Marco.
facts.excerpt: just one minute away from Piazza San Marco

facts.text: The Marco Polo Ballroom is surrounded by original 18th-century frescoes.
facts.excerpt: in the splendid Marco Polo Ballroom, surrounded by original 18th-century frescoes

facts.text: Superior Rooms have original period furniture and original Murano chandeliers.
facts.excerpt: Original Venetian Style, original period furniture, original Murano chandeliers.

facts.text: Canal View Rooms look onto a side canal and the Royal Gardens, with gondolas passing below.
facts.excerpt: these rooms allow you to gaze down at the gondolas floating by, as well as the Royal Gardens.

facts.text: The Giorgione Terrace Suite has an Altana, a raised wooden terrace overlooking the roofs of the city.
facts.excerpt: You’ll also love the Altana, a raised wooden terrace overlooking the roofs of the city.

facts.text: Lagoon-view suites look over the San Marco Basin and San Giorgio Island.
facts.excerpt: this Junior Suite offers maximum comfort and a splendid view of the San Marco Basin & San Giorgio Island.

facts.text: The San Giorgio Terrace Suite 2-Bedroom has the hotel's largest terrace, with views of San Giorgio Island.
facts.excerpt: Open the doors to our largest hotel terrace, which offers breathtaking views of San Giorgio Island.

facts.text: The Goldoni Family Suite has a separate living area and two bedrooms.
facts.excerpt: this Suite consists of a separate living area and two elegant bedrooms, one with a king-size bed and the other with a French bed.

facts.text: Superior Rooms include Acqua di Parma bathroom amenities.
facts.excerpt: ACQUA DI PARMA bathroom amenities

facts.text: Santo Mare serves Italian seafood in a fishmonger-inspired setting.
facts.excerpt: Taste the finest in Italian seafood—showcasing the freshest catches, paired with Italian mastery, in a stylish fishmonger-inspired setting.

facts.text: The Canova Bar serves espresso, aperitivo and cocktails, plus a selection of light fare.
facts.excerpt: Whether you’re seeking an espresso, pre-dinner aperitivo, or an original cocktail, Canova Bar will delight the sophisticated palate.

facts.text: The hotel's experiences include a VIP after-hours Doge's Palace tour.
facts.excerpt: VIP After Hours Doge’s Palace Tour – Exclusive Tour

facts.text: The hotel's experiences include a private Riva boat tour.
facts.excerpt: Venice Boat Lifestyle – A Private Riva Boat Tour

facts.text: The hotel's experiences include creating your own Carnival mask.
facts.excerpt: Create your own Carnival Mask

facts.text: The interiors have period furnishings, frescoed ceilings, Murano glass and bronze accents.
facts.excerpt: from authentic period furnishings & glorious frescoed ceilings to beautiful Murano glass & bronze accents.

facts.text: Nearby attractions include the Bridge of Sighs, Doge's Palace, Harry's Bar and the Rialto Bridge.
facts.excerpt:
Bridge of Sighs

• Doge’s Palace

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler says the Salone Marco Polo, where breakfast is served, was entirely frescoed by pupils of Tiepolo.
facts.excerpt: Breakfast is served in the Salone Marco Polo, entirely frescoed by pupils of Tiepolo

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler says a private canal makes for a remarkable arrival and departure.
facts.excerpt: A private canal makes for "a remarkable arrival and departure experience" at this hotel

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler calls it the oldest hotel in Venice.
facts.excerpt: the oldest in Venice and the closest to St. Mark’s Square

facts.text: Superior Rooms are described as the perfect choice for those who won't settle for less than the best.
facts.excerpt: Our Superior Rooms are the perfect choice for anyone who won’t settle for less than the best accommodations.

contradictions.note: Official dining page lists Canova as a bar with light fare and Santo Mare as the restaurant; Conde Nast Traveler (older review) describes Canova as a restaurant serving Venetian specialties.
